game_concept: A puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Basalt Stair, a basalt column stairway: the forge smith must handle magma slimes while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Input Interpreter: Read simulated input() answers from villagers, cast them, and respond correctly.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Basalt Stair: a basalt column stairway
core_gameplay_loop: In Basalt Stair, repeat each round: Read simulated input() answers from villagers, cast them, and respond correctly. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the trust value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the ash barrier using at most 11 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The ash barrier reached with actions_used <= 11.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 11 before the ash barrier is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 3 (intro tier): Input Interpreter
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Input Interpreter' (Week 2 slot 10), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Basalt Stair'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how trust changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against magma slimes in Basalt Stair.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The ash barrier reached with actions_used <= 11.
